text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit vehicles over 2.0 metres in width within the first laneway north of Geary Avenue, between Westmoreland Avenue North and Dovercourt Road. This regulation will lessen the possibility of property damage caused by large vehicles.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling in the first laneway north of Geary Avenue, between Westmoreland Avenue North and Dovercourt Road.
